title: 第70章 溪旁除疲累 偶获护心草第69章 彻夜锻寒铁 新甲赴溪途
lines: 天光彻底大亮，清晨的薄雾尽数被山风扫散，通透日光穿透层层叠叠的枝叶，细碎光斑错落洒落整片青岩溪涧的青石地面。
一夜静谧值守、彻夜锻甲制器的疲惫萦绕在眉眼之间，罗止正心性沉稳，神色淡然从容，半点倦意未曾外露。
他垂眸扫过两人一身崭新的兵刃防具，眼底生出几分安稳笃定，如今攻防兼备，再无往日破绽。
罗止正侧首看向身旁的李紫云，语气沉稳平缓：“休整完毕，我们继续探索青岩溪涧后段。”
李紫云微微颔首，低头轻轻抬动小腿，细致感受着寒霜鳞胫甲与水鳞护膝铠的贴合质感。
整套鳞甲轻便贴身、毫无坠感，内衬猿兽软皮温润柔和，行走屈伸寂静无声，防护与灵动兼顾。
她眉眼微舒，眼底掠过一抹安稳笑意，轻声应道：“好。”
一旁的随峰振展收拢的双翼，身形彻底舒展，澄澈灵眸缓缓扫视一圈周遭静谧山林，确认无任何灵兽异动后，主动踱步至二人身侧。
周身萦绕凡级三阶后期的稳固灵力，姿态警觉，随时待命。
罗止正抬手拾起斜靠青石的岩纹寒铁枪，紧实修长的枪杆握于掌心，手感沉稳厚重。
后腰收纳的焚炎岳灵刃贴合腰背轮廓，隐匿利落，完全不碍行动。
双腿玄墨护膝铠与爆炎鳞胫甲穿戴规整，全副武装，已然整装待发。
他旋即缓步走到篝火旁的青石台边，俯身抬手，将台上剩余未消耗的灵鳄肉、储备兽筋、完整备用鳄鳞等所有战利品，逐一尽数收拢，稳妥纳入储物袋中妥善存放。
另一侧，李紫云顺势握住身侧的灵角寒霜弓，轻步走到火堆旁。
她指尖微微凝动，一缕清透凛冽的冰系灵力自指尖倏然迸发，精准覆上残余炭火。
低温寒气瞬间裹覆燥热火堆，滋滋白雾骤然腾起，残存火星、余温尽数被冰寒灵力压制湮灭。
短短瞬息，残余篝火彻底熄灭，杜绝了林间明火遗留的隐患。
一切收拾妥当，烟尘散尽、踪迹隐去、隐患消除，二人一宠目光齐齐望向青岩溪涧幽深莫测的后段密林，准备踏入全新的探索区域。
下一瞬，随峰双翼轻轻一振，身躯利落腾空而起，掠至前路数丈的林间低空。
它双翼舒展张开，稳稳悬停浮空，锐利的眼眸俯瞰整片溪涧幽暗林地，双耳敏锐颤动，全方位探查前路气息与异动，先行探路。
罗止正单手攥紧岩纹寒铁枪，缓步在后开路，目光扫视溪涧近处石缝、岸边地面，排查兽迹，周身灵力缓缓流转。
李紫云左手握住灵角寒霜弓紧随罗止正身后，视线紧盯高处林木与幽深密林深处，提防暗处偷袭，指尖萦绕淡淡冰灵力。
二人一宠顺着狭长溪涧小径缓步前行约莫一里路，涧底平地缓缓小幅抬升，化作微抬缓坡，溪流水道慢慢收窄，水流流速放缓，水面静缓。
两侧岩壁间距稍稍拓宽，视野对比中段舒展些许。
土层慢慢增厚，零散乱石变少，涧岸草木肆意丛生，枝叶交错。
上层林木枝叶层层交叠，细碎阳光穿过叶隙，落下斑驳晃动的光点，大部分区域沉在灰蓝暗影之中。
山间湿气长久不散，潮湿薄雾飘荡在林木之间，整条谷涧纵深幽深，树丛、岩缝、低洼处皆是灵兽藏身的隐蔽点位，氛围沉寂压抑。
二人一宠正式进入青岩溪涧后段。
高空之上，随峰缓慢盘旋前行，羽翼带起极轻的风声，灵识尽数铺开，细致排查树冠、灌丛、石缝等所有灵兽可藏匿的死角。
但凡有半分异常气息波动，皆逃不过它的感知。
罗止正脚步微顿，抬眸缓缓环顾周遭幽暗静谧的溪涧，随后侧首看向身侧的少女，嗓音温润平缓：“走了这么久，口渴了，先去溪边喝点水吧。”
李紫云眉眼轻软微微颔首，步伐轻顿，轻声应答：“嗯，好。”
两人并肩缓步走到溪水岸边，一同屈膝蹲下身子，双手合拢捧起清冽冰凉的溪水，低头小口细细饮用。
高空侦查的随峰见二人驻足饮水，当即收敛振动的羽翼，轻盈落至两人身侧，微微垂首凑近溪面，安静低头饮水。
罗止正喝完水，抬手用手背擦去唇角残留水渍，伸手自腰间解下银月水囊，拔开木塞，将水囊浸入溪水灌满，重新堵紧塞子，抬手将水囊牢牢系回腰间。
罗止正微微凑近，鼻尖靠近李紫云肩头轻嗅，嘴角勾起戏谑笑意，轻声打趣：“紫云，你有没有闻到一股臭味呀？”
李紫云睫毛轻颤，往后微微偏身避开，抬手捂住肩头，杏眼微瞪，脸颊泛起浅红，语气略带嗔怪：“罗止正你什么意思呀，是嫌我臭囖？”
罗止正抬臂轻挠后颈，笑意藏在眼底，语气温和：“我可没有嫌弃，只是一路风餐露宿，身上积了尘土汗渍。”
李紫云抬手闻了闻自己衣袖，随即探身凑近他肩头嗅了嗅，嘴角噙着促狭，语气轻快：“彼此彼此，你身上味道同样明显。”
罗止正侧身稍稍避让，被她逗得低笑，右手伸入溪水试探水温：“要不我们在此洗漱一番。”
李紫云指尖碰一碰微凉溪水，斜睨着他，眉眼含笑：“好吧，被你这么一说我们好像也有一段时间没有洗漱了。”
随峰静静站在岸边，来回扫视四周树丛，负责警戒。
罗止正依次取下随身物件：先卸下玄岳镇鳞铠，褪去烈焰分指拳套、爆炎鳞臂甲、爆炎鳞胫甲、玄墨护膝铠，平放青石；再将岩纹寒铁枪斜靠石边，焚炎岳灵刃解下挨着长枪放置。
岩纹储物袋、银月水囊、骨针全数取下，整齐摆放在青石平整处。
罗止正侧身看向一旁的李紫云，语气平和：“青石隐蔽，装备放此处，不会被溪水打湿。”
content_en:
The sky was completely bright, and all the early morning mist was swept away by the mountain wind. The transparent sunlight penetrated through the layers of branches and leaves, and scattered light spots scattered across the bluestone ground of the Qingyan Stream.
The fatigue of a night of quiet duty and all-night forging armor and weapons lingered between his brows and eyes. Luo Zhizheng's mind was calm, his expression was calm and calm, and he did not show any signs of fatigue.
He lowered his eyes and glanced at the brand-new weapons and armor of the two people, and there was a sense of stability and determination in his eyes. Now they were both offensive and defensive, and there were no flaws in the past.
Luo Zhizheng looked sideways at Li Ziyun beside him, and said in a calm and gentle tone: "After resting, we will continue to explore the back section of Qingyan Stream."
Li Ziyun nodded slightly, lowered his head and gently lifted his calf, carefully feeling the fit of the frost scale greaves and water scale knee armor.
The entire set of scale armor is light and close-fitting, with no feeling of falling. It is lined with soft ape leather, which is warm and soft. It can bend and stretch silently while walking, giving both protection and agility.
Her eyebrows relaxed slightly, a steady smile flashed across her eyes, and she responded softly: "Okay."
Suifeng on the side spread out his folded wings, completely stretched his figure, and his clear eyes slowly scanned the surrounding quiet mountains and forests. After confirming that there was no movement of any spiritual beasts, he took the initiative to walk to the two of them.
The solid spiritual power of the late third-level mortal level lingers around him, his posture is alert, and he is ready for action at any time.
Luo Zhizheng raised his hand to pick up the rock-patterned cold iron gun leaning against the bluestone. He held the tight and slender gun shaft in his palm, feeling steady and heavy in his hand.
The Burning Flame Yue Spirit Blade stored in the lower back fits the contour of the waist and back, is neatly concealed, and does not hinder movement at all.
The black black knee armor and explosive scale greaves on both legs are neatly dressed, fully armed, and ready for action.
He immediately walked slowly to the bluestone platform next to the bonfire, leaned over and raised his hands to collect all the remaining unconsumed spiritual crocodile meat, reserve animal tendons, complete spare crocodile scales and other trophies on the platform one by one, and put them securely into a storage bag for safe storage.
On the other side, Li Ziyun took advantage of the opportunity to hold the Spirit Horn Frost Bow at his side and walked lightly to the fire.
Her fingertips moved slightly, and a wisp of clear and cold ice spiritual power suddenly burst out from her fingertips, accurately covering the remaining charcoal fire.
The low-temperature cold air instantly enveloped the hot fire, and the white mist suddenly rose. The remaining sparks and remaining warmth were suppressed and annihilated by the cold spiritual power.
In just a short moment, the remaining campfire was completely extinguished, eliminating the hidden dangers left by the open fire in the forest.
After everything was tidied up, the smoke and dust dissipated, the traces disappeared, and the hidden dangers were eliminated, the two of them looked at the deep and unpredictable forest at the back of Qingyan Stream, preparing to step into a new exploration area.
The next moment, Suifeng's wings flapped slightly, and his body soared neatly into the air, flying to a low altitude in the forest a few feet ahead.
Its wings were stretched out and it hovered steadily in the air. Its sharp eyes overlooked the entire dark woodland of the stream, and its ears vibrated keenly to detect the smell and movement of the road ahead, exploring the path first.
Luo Zhizheng held the rock-patterned cold iron spear tightly with one hand and slowly opened the way behind him. His eyes scanned the cracks in the rocks near the stream and the ground on the bank, checking for traces of animals. His spiritual energy slowly circulated around his body.
Li Ziyun held the Spirit Horned Frost Bow in his left hand and followed closely behind Luo Zhizheng. His eyes were fixed on the high trees and the depths of the deep forest, guarding against sneak attacks in the dark. A faint ice spiritual power lingered on his fingertips.
The two of them walked slowly along the long and narrow stream path for about a mile. The flat ground at the bottom of the stream slowly rose slightly and turned into a gentle slope. The stream channel slowly narrowed, the water flow slowed down, and the water surface became calm.
The distance between the rock walls on both sides is slightly wider, and the field of view is slightly wider than in the middle.
The soil layer gradually thickens, the scattered rocks become fewer, and the vegetation on the stream bank grows wildly, with intertwined branches and leaves.
The branches and leaves of the upper forest trees overlap in layers, and the fragments of sunlight pass through the gaps between the leaves, falling into mottled and swaying light spots. Most of the area is sunk in gray-blue shadows.
The moisture in the mountains persists for a long time, and the moist mist floats between the trees. The entire valley is deep and deep. The trees, rock crevices, and low-lying places are all hidden spots for spiritual beasts to hide. The atmosphere is quiet and depressing.
The two of them officially entered the back section of Qingyan Creek.
High in the sky, he slowly circled forward with the peak, his wings carried the gentle sound of wind, and his spiritual consciousness spread out, carefully checking the tree crowns, bushes, stone crevices and other blind spots where spiritual beasts could hide.
Any abnormal aura fluctuations cannot escape its perception.
Luo Zhizheng paused slightly, raised his eyes and slowly looked around the dark and quiet stream. Then he looked sideways at the girl beside him, and said in a warm and gentle voice: "After walking for so long, I'm thirsty. Let's go to the stream to drink some water first."
Li Ziyun nodded slightly with soft eyebrows, paused in steps, and responded softly: "Yes, okay."
The two walked slowly side by side to the bank of the stream, knelt down together, put their hands together to hold the clear and cold stream water, lowered their heads and drank it in small sips.
When Sui Feng, who was conducting high-altitude reconnaissance, saw the two of them stopping to drink water, he immediately restrained his vibrating wings and lightly landed beside them. He slightly bowed his head and approached the stream, quietly lowering his head to drink water.
Luo Zhizheng finished drinking the water, raised his hand to wipe the remaining water stains from the corners of his lips, reached out to untie the silver moon water bag from his waist, pulled out the cork, immersed the water bag in the stream and filled it up, tightened the stopper, and raised his hand to tie the water bag firmly back to his waist.
Luo Zhizheng came slightly closer, with the tip of his nose close to Li Ziyun's shoulder and sniffed lightly, with a playful smile on his lips, and joked softly: "Ziyun, do you smell a bad smell?"
Li Ziyun's eyelashes trembled slightly, she leaned back slightly, raised her hands to cover her shoulders, her almond-shaped eyes widened slightly, her cheeks turned light red, and her tone was slightly angry: "Luo Zhizheng, what do you mean, do you think I stink?"
Luo Zhizheng raised his arm to scratch the back of his neck, with a smile hidden in his eyes, and said in a gentle tone: "I don't dislike it, it's just that I have been eating and sleeping all the way, and my body has accumulated dust and sweat."
Li Ziyun raised his hand and smelled his sleeve, then leaned forward to his shoulder and sniffed, with a frown at the corner of his mouth and a brisk tone: "Both of us, the smell on you is equally obvious."
Luo Zhizheng turned sideways for a moment, and was amused by her. He laughed softly. He put his right hand into the stream to test the water temperature: "Why don't we wash up here?"
Li Ziyun touched the cool stream water with her fingertips, looked at him sideways, and said with a smile on her face: "Well, from what you said, it seems that we haven't washed up for a while."
Sui Feng stood quietly on the shore, scanning the surrounding trees back and forth, taking charge of the alert.
Luo Zhizheng took off his belongings in order: first, he took off the Xuanyue Suppressing Scale Armor, took off the Flame Finger Gloves, the Explosive Flame Scale Arm Armor, the Explosive Flame Scale Greaves, and the Black Ink Knee Armor, and laid the bluestone flat; then he leaned the rock-patterned cold iron spear against the edge of the stone, and removed the Burning Flame Yue Spirit Blade and placed it next to the spear.
The rock pattern storage bag, silver moon water bag, and bone needles were all removed and placed neatly on the flat surface of the bluestone.
Luo Zhizheng turned sideways and looked at Li Ziyun aside, and said in a calm tone: "The bluestone is hidden. Put the equipment here so it won't get wet by the stream."
title_en: Chapter 70: Relieving fatigue by the stream and occasionally finding the heart-protecting grass. Chapter 69: Forging cold iron all night long, the new armor goes to the stream.
